If a variable vv (observed or factor) is dependent, then the reference

vv

applies to the residual variance of vv rather than to vv itself.

So if vv is dependent on some other variable, then 

vv~~zz

(where zz is some other variable) enables a free covariance between vv and zz or rht residual of zz, if zz is also dependent.

However, if zz is dependent on vv, as in:

zz ~ vv

Then alowing a free residual covariance violates a basic assumption of OLS regression and may make the model "not identified," so that it cannot be estimated. Read about "instrumental variables" in structural equations if you want to learn about how to estimate such a coefficient.
